nodes.description: ALFA_BANK.Put(uint _unlockTime) public payable: credits msg.value to the caller's Holder entry and stores an unlock time derived from now.
ALFA_BANK.Collect(uint _am) public payable: checks balance/unlockTime then performs an external call before decreasing the recorded balance, enabling reentrancy.
ALFA_BANK fallback function() public payable: forwards to Put(0), so any plain transfer creates a deposit entry.
ALFA_BANK constructor(address log): binds the external Log contract used for logging messages.
Log.AddMessage(address _adr,uint _val,string _data) public: writes the supplied data plus block.timestamp into LastMsg and appends it to History.
mapping(address => Holder) public Acc: per-caller balance and unlockTime storage, read and written by Put and Collect.
Log LogFile: reference to the external logging contract invoked by Put and Collect.
uint public MinSum = 1 ether: minimum balance required before Collect will pay out.
Message[] public History: append-only log of messages written by AddMessage.
Message LastMsg: scratch storage struct filled by AddMessage before being pushed to History.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as mapping key, as log argument and as the target of the external value call.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time used for the unlockTime comparison and for LastMsg.Time.
msg.sender.call.value(_am)(): unchecked low-level value transfer to an untrusted address, executed before the balance is debited.
acc.balance += msg.value: unchecked integer addition on the Holder balance field.
acc.balance -= _am: unchecked integer subtraction performed only after the external call returns successfully.
Parameter _unlockTime of Put, used to compute the stored unlock time.
Parameter _am of Collect, the withdraw amount checked against balance and passed to the external call.
Parameter log of the ALFA_BANK constructor, the address of the Log contract.
Parameter _adr of AddMessage, the recorded message sender.
Parameter _val of AddMessage, the recorded value.
Parameter _data of AddMessage, the recorded string payload.
var acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Put: storage reference used to update balance and unlockTime.
var acc = Acc[msg.sender] inside Collect: storage reference whose balance is read for the guard and written after the call.

edges.reason: Put reads msg.sender to index the Acc mapping and to log the deposit.
acc is initialized from Acc[msg.sender], so the untrusted caller selects the storage slot.
Collect uses msg.sender both as the storage key and as the destination of the external value call.
The balances consulted by Collect belong to the attacker-controlled msg.sender entry.
AddMessage records the caller-supplied address into LastMsg.Sender.
Put derives unlockTime from now, letting the miner influence the locking period.
Collect gates the withdrawal on now > acc.unlockTime, a timestamp-dependent condition.
AddMessage writes the current block timestamp into LastMsg.Time.
LastMsg.Time is assigned from now, storing a miner-influenced value in state.
_unlockTime flows into the caller's Holder entry via acc.unlockTime.
Mutations through acc are persisted into the Acc mapping.
_am is validated against acc.balance before being paid out.
State read from Acc[msg.sender] drives the Collect guard.
The requested amount read from storage is forwarded to the untrusted external call.
The value transfer re-enters Collect before acc.balance is decremented, allowing repeated withdrawals.
A plain value transfer into ALFA_BANK triggers the fallback, which re-deposits on behalf of the attacker.
The fallback function unconditionally invokes Put(0) with a zero unlock time.
The balance debit executes only after the external call returns, so state is stale during the call.
Put reads and writes the Acc mapping for the caller.
Collect reads and writes the Acc mapping for the caller.
MinSum is compared against acc.balance in the Collect guard.
Put writes a log entry through LogFile.AddMessage.
Collect writes a log entry through LogFile.AddMessage after a successful withdrawal.
The unchecked balance addition is committed to the Acc mapping.
acc.balance += msg.value performs unchecked integer arithmetic on storage.
The unchecked balance subtraction is committed to the Acc mapping.
acc.balance -= _am performs unchecked integer arithmetic on storage.
Put calls the external Log contract (LogFile.AddMessage).
Collect calls the external Log contract (LogFile.AddMessage) inside the withdrawal branch.
The constructor stores the supplied Log address into the LogFile state variable.
The log parameter is wrapped into a Log interface by the constructor.
_adr is written into LastMsg.Sender.
_val is written into LastMsg.Val.
_data is written into LastMsg.Data.
AddMessage populates the LastMsg storage struct.
LastMsg is pushed into the History array.
AddMessage appends to the History log array.

normalization_plan.reason: _unlockTime is only used to set the caller's unlock time inside Put, so it can be folded into the Put function node.
_am only participates in the Collect guard and payout, so it can be folded into the Collect function node.
log is only consumed by the constructor when initializing LogFile, so it can be folded into the constructor node.
_adr is only written into LastMsg.Sender by AddMessage, so it can be folded into the AddMessage function node.
_val is only written into LastMsg.Val by AddMessage, so it can be folded into the AddMessage function node.
_data is only written into LastMsg.Data by AddMessage, so it can be folded into the AddMessage function node.
The local acc pointer is created and used exclusively inside Put for the deposit arithmetic.
The local acc pointer in Collect supplies both the guard values and the amount sent to the unsafe external call, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
